==Description==
'''Paradoxum Translators''' was a translation program from [[Paradoxum Games]] with the goal of translating Tower Defense Simulator into multiple languages. The program is nowadays defunct as it has been replaced by Roblox's automatic translations.

The position initially was a voluntary position which only granted small in-game benefits, but would later be turned into a paid position.

==Ranks==
The '''Paradoxum Translators''' group had 24 ranks, these are:
*Member (1)
*Spanish (2)
*Korean (3)
*German (4)
*Malay (5)
*Japanese (6)
*Russian (7)
*Portuguese (8)
*Vietnamese (9)
*French (10)
*Turkish (11)
*Romanian (12)
*Thai (13)
*Indonesian (14)
*Lithuanian (15)
*Czech (16)
*Dutch (17)
*Italian (18)
*Filipino (19)
*Hindi (26)
*Bulgarian (28)
*Polish (29)
*Supervisor (254)
*Manager (255)

The position was originally voluntary, with it only having some in-game benefits like a custom in-game skin, a translator [[Title|Flair]] and other in-game incentives, though none of the benefits appear to have ever been added. Later, these benefits would be scrapped entirely as translation would be turned into a paid position with a reward of {{Robux|15}} per translated string, but similarly there is no known instance of someone actually getting paid.

The only known benefit that was actually given out was a role in the Tower Defense Simulator Discord server, which based on old messages has existed since December of 2019 and was removed around the 7th of January 2020.
